title: A. Marisa Steals Reimu's Takeout
statement:
Marisa is a girl of integrity who always helps others safeguard their belongings. Over a period of n days, she comes each day to take one of Reimu's takeouts. The i-th takeout is described by its deliciousness value — an integer w_i (0≤ w_i≤ 2), forming a sequence w of length n.

Marisa has a special fondness for the number 3. She can perform the following operation zero or more times:

Determine the maximum number of operations Marisa can perform.

^{∗}A sequence a is a subsequence of a sequence b if a can be obtained from b by the deletion of several (possibly, zero or all) element from arbitrary positions.

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t (1 ≤ t ≤ 500). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer n (1≤ n ≤ 100).

The second line contains n integers w_1, w_2, …, w_n (0≤ w_i ≤ 2), denoting the deliciousness values of the takeouts.

For each test case, output the maximum number of operations Marisa can perform.

In the first test case, Marisa can perform four operations: [underline0,0,0,0]→[underline0,0,0]→[underline0,0]→[underline0]→ [].

In the second test case, Marisa can perform two operations: [underline1,underline2,0]- > [underline0]- > [].

In the third test case, Marisa can perform two operations: [underline1,2,1,underline2,1]- > [underline2,1,underline1]- > [1].

Input:
```
340 0 0 031 2 051 2 1 2 1
```

Output:
```
422
```
